supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceGoal: Let’s learn about different units we can use to measure area.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Describe square units based on different linear units of measurement. Use square inches and square centimeters to measure the area of a rectangle.
teachingSteps: Identify unit squares and the area being measured.
Represent the shape or rectangle with equal-area units.
Calculate or compare area with units and check any decomposition.
